member.name: T:MindAttic.Capture.CaptureArgs
member.summary:
Parses the -capture flag — the only way to turn capture on; there is no environment variable or auto-loaded project config, so a plain launch is always a plain launch:
-capture or -capture video: record the app's window from start to exit at native resolution.
-capture screen 5: a PNG every 5 seconds (any duration: 500ms, 10s, 1m) for as long as the app runs.
-capture video screen 5: both. Add hq for a hardware-HEVC tape instead of lossless.
-capture video 8h: stop after 8 hours (resource limits can stop it sooner; see ).
-capture-config capture.json: explicitly load settings and trigger rules from a file.
